comparison.objective: Insert a battery with correct polarity and screw a flashlight cap onto real thread geometry; candidate transfers an uncaged bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests cylindrical insertion, orientation selection, body stabilization, thread engagement, and sustained rotation. Candidate tests flush support alignment and linear block transfer across a seam.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires correct battery polarity, cap thread engagement and at least 300 degrees of tightening, no forced seating or dropped part, and stillness. Candidate requires complete transfer with every ball contained and continuous support.
comparison.reason: Threaded enclosure assembly is a different mechanism from maintaining a bearing raceway through a rail-to-jig transition.
